scripts.check:lua: ((command -v lua >/dev/null 2>&1) >/dev/null 2>&1) || (echo 'Lua not installed. Please install Lua before proceeding.' && exit 1)
scripts.publish: npm run build && smartthings edge:channels:assign $(npm run --silent driver:id) --channel 912e7705-ec88-413c-a3ac-1c5ecd9015ba
scripts.deploy: npm run publish && npm run link
scripts.deploy:install: npm run deploy && npm run hub-install
scripts.test: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua all
scripts.test:unit: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua integration
scripts.test:integration:get_mode: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua integration get_mode
scripts.test:integration:switch: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua integration switch
scripts.test:integration:brightness: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua integration brightness
scripts.test:integration:rgb_color: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua integration rgb_color
scripts.test:integration:hsv_color: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua integration hsv_color
scripts.test:integration:list_effects: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua integration list_effects
scripts.test:integration:list_builtin_effects: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua integration list_builtin_effects
scripts.test:integration:list_user_effects: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua integration list_user_effects
scripts.test:integration:activate_effects: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua integration activate_effects
scripts.test:integration:get_current_effect: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua integration get_current_effect
scripts.test:integration:random_effect: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua integration random_effect
scripts.test:integration:effects_mode_switching: npm run check:lua && lua run-tests.lua integration effects_mode_switching
scripts.test:integration:raw: npm run check:lua && RAW_RESPONSES=true lua run-tests.lua integration
scripts.test:integration:get_mode:raw: npm run check:lua && RAW_RESPONSES=true lua run-tests.lua integration get_mode
scripts.test:integration:switch:raw: npm run check:lua && RAW_RESPONSES=true lua run-tests.lua integration switch
scripts.test:integration:brightness:raw: npm run check:lua && RAW_RESPONSES=true lua run-tests.lua integration brightness
scripts.test:integration:rgb_color:raw: npm run check:lua && RAW_RESPONSES=true lua run-tests.lua integration rgb_color
scripts.test:integration:hsv_color:raw: npm run check:lua && RAW_RESPONSES=true lua run-tests.lua integration hsv_color
scripts.test:integration:list_effects:raw: npm run check:lua && RAW_RESPONSES=true lua run-tests.lua integration list_effects
scripts.test:on: npm run check:lua && lua test.lua on $IP
scripts.test:off: npm run check:lua && lua test.lua off $IP
scripts.test:get: npm run check:lua && lua test.lua get $IP
scripts.test:bright: npm run check:lua && lua test.lua brightness $IP $LEVEL
scripts.test:color: npm run check:lua && lua test.lua color $IP $HUE $SAT $VAL
scripts.test:rgb: npm run check:lua && lua test.lua rgb $IP $RED $GREEN $BLUE
scripts.version: npm run version:bump && npm run version:tag
scripts.version:tag: git add . && git commit -m "chore(release): v$npm_package_version" && git tag v$npm_package_version && git push && git push --tags
